name: Keep Angular components focused and colocated
statement: Keep a component focused on one UI responsibility, colocate its template, styles, and tests, and move reusable state or integration behavior into an injected service.
rationale: Focused components are easier to review, test, and render efficiently. Quality Studio follows feature folders with sibling component, template, style, and specification files instead of page-wide grab bags.

history.change: Initial Angular component-structure rule grounded in the Quality Studio feature-folder layout.
